info.name: Azure Monitor Action Groups Logs Ingestion API
Azure Monitor Upload logs to a custom table

params.name: ruleId
params.description: The immutable ID of the data collection rule resource.

params.name: stream
params.description: The name of the stream to send data to. For built-in tables, use the stream name format like Custom-TableName. For custom tables, use Custom-TableName_CL.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for this operation.

items.docs: Ingests log data to a Log Analytics workspace via a data collection rule. The data is sent to the specified stream, which is mapped to a table in the workspace by the data collection rule. Supports JSON arrays of log records.
